name: North Star

contribution_model.verified_in_origin: An inspected execution record supports bounded origin behavior; applicability remains a hypothesis.
contribution_model.adapted: A real implementation exists in a new context, beyond planning.

contribution_model.externally_validated: Relevant destination behavior/experience has independent evaluation; specify what and by whom.

evidence_boundary: Unity/C# is the selected production stack; Windows is priority and Steam intended. Retained Godot local-prototype evidence remains valid. C# domain/destination execution is distinct from unavailable Unity Editor, unexecuted Windows player, Steamworks, shared-world scale and independent human validation.

capabilities.destination_scope: Atomic bounded in-memory material/output ownership with recipe/station/unlock validation, local replay/conflict ledger, one-encounter rig consumption and no-refund retry in original connected C# terminal encounters; no persistence, multiplayer, Unity, Windows or Steam execution.

capabilities.title: RPG domain and durable session recovery
capabilities.scope: Pure C# turn-based rescue domain, supply consequences, replay-validated saves and native Linux delivery.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Local continuation preserves existing meaningful choice investment; human comprehension, Windows/Unity integration and future service applicability remain hypotheses.
capabilities.limits: New Cinderwatch implementation; not recovered RGSS code. Local session saves do not establish account persistence or server trust.
capabilities.next_validation: Compare authored narrative/world consequences and remaining incomplete laboratories; validate actual Windows filesystem/Unity integration and explicit migration before account or cloud claims.
capabilities.destination_scope: Actual prepared expedition preserved by bounded full accepted-command replay, local exclusive file ownership, content-bound receipts and commit-before-publication across Linux process restart/failure. Identity, slots, XP/allocation, supplies and active encounter state recover together. Prior eligibility/progression evidence remains separately retained; no historical format import, account/server, Windows, Unity, Steam or power-loss proof.

capabilities.title: Movement and action combat feedback
capabilities.scope: Native physics, committed locked contact, paid close-sweep guard, phase hazards, animation and scripted engine checks.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: The local crossing demonstrates distinct finite-resource protection/redirection paths; perceived character identity and broader combat applicability remain hypotheses requiring player observation.
capabilities.limits: Single-player desktop timing; not lag compensation, networked combat, human balance or multiplayer prediction.
capabilities.next_validation: Observe actual unassisted players explaining direction, interception, feint and reachable counters before judging identity, fairness or balance.
capabilities.destination_scope: One local courier encounter adapts P06 contact/commitment methodology into finite-resource frontal protection versus locked-line redirection, not shared-code import. Real-model rehearsal freezes causal review and starts a clean crossing. Guardian selects sustained Steady or 60-300ms Riposte with a confirmed 1.6s opening. Three eligible close counters stop this sentinel and double courier pace; gate/survival still own success and pure protection remains complete. Optional medicine needs actual timed recovery and a separate moving handoff while threats continue. Earned, voluntarily worn cosmetic marks and recoverable twelve-action remaps use editable device-local profiles. Independent session-only guard/interaction toggles preserve costs, timing and commitment; interruption/completion disarm intentions. Read-only original actor gestures expose actual events. This is bounded destination adaptation/production, not P10 dialogue/P07 atlas import, NS-C13 promotion, human identity/accessibility/balance validation, account/MMO integration or final class/canon approval. A reversible native preparation workshop makes a data-defined health/mobility/recovery fitting for either approach; no origin economy import, profession progression, new capability promotion or persistent power. An optional committed courier detour adds real travel distance and partial geometric bolt interception with distinct ownership; no floor immunity, free opening, origin import or final geography approval. Optional continuation carries actual arrival health/energy and fitting into a stationary-winch, two-catch and alive-exit objective; existing paid defenses/counters serve both work-first and shutdown-first routes. That continuation introduced no additional capability state, canon or human validation. Free appearance has independent skin, hair and cloth choices, shared actual drawing/action previews and explicit draft/apply/discard; default art and actual mechanics remain. Explicit apply now retains bounded skin/hair/dye indices through the recoverable local cosmetic profile; legacy migration and actual process reentry are executed. No recognition, full creator, account or persistent RPG power claim. A fixed mapped-gamepad adapter now serves the same complete adventure, with contextual hints, modal quarantine and explicit interruption recovery. Injected events verify source/PCK/release behavior, not physical controllers or accessibility. Validated JSON now supplies the real workshop, combat and supported outfit visuals; Field sash trades one health for faster unguarded recovery. A staged new identifier/value definition executes without code changes. This is original destination production, not an origin extraction, new capability state or profession system.
